name: @inneranimalmedia/iamscene
purpose: Portable editable .iamscene.json format, deterministic scene authoring and animation runtime, Three.js presentation, and required AgentSam OCCT geometry pipeline.
use_when: Creating, editing, validating, versioning, animating and showcasing portable 3D scenes in any supported JavaScript application
Using .iamscene.json as the editable source of truth and GLTF/GLB as interchange or presentation assets
Building precise scene geometry through the canonical @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-occt engine
avoid_when: Replacing canonical CAD project history or CAD Creator project authority
Using a rendered GLB as the only editable source for a scene
